answer: Give each identity a hash-chained thread of its own work: every answer must cite the hash of its previous one, and a randomly assigned peer countersigns each link. Rewards scale with the unbroken length of that chain, capped at one link per epoch, so seniority cannot be bought, only lived. Standing is an ember that cools the moment a link is missed, and an operator running a lagoon of clones must keep hundreds of threads alive in parallel, each witnessed by strangers who spot recycled content.
